translations.With your permission, SEEKVERA uses your: Ngemvume yakho, i-SEEKVERA isebenzisa indawo yefoni yakho ukuze ibheke izindawo eziseduze kudatha ye-OpenStreetMap ezimakwe nge-Wi-Fi noma ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Ukutholakala kunikezwa umphakathi futhi kungase kungabi okwamanje.

translations.You may use SEEKVERA only for lawful pro: Ungasebenzisa i-SEEKVERA kuphela emikhiqizweni esemthethweni, izinsizakalo, uhambo, impahla, imisebenzi, amabhizinisi kanye nolwazi. Kufanele ulandele imithetho esebenza kuwe, into noma isevisi, kanye nezwe lapho umsebenzi wenzeka khona.

translations.Some current or future tracked links may: Ezinye izixhumanisi zamanje noma zesikhathi esizayo ezilandelwayo zingasebenzisa amakhukhi noma ubuchwepheshe bokuchaza ngaphansi komhlinzeki wendawo noma inqubomgomo yobumfihlo yenethiwekhi ephethwe. translations.Users must verify identity, ownership, t: Abasebenzisi kufanele baqinisekise ubunikazi, ubunikazi, amadokhumenti etayitela, ubuqiniso bomkhiqizo, amalayisense, izimvume, amanani neziyalezo zokukhokha ngaphambi kokuqeda umsebenzi. translations.SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a us: SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a user completes a qualifying purchase, booking, subscription or referral through certain tracked links. translations.SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that inv: SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that involve prohibited or illegal goods, services or content. translations.By posting an ad, you confirm that you o: By posting an ad, you confirm that you own the item/property/content or are authorized by the owner to advertise it. translations.Weapons, ammunition, explosives, militar: Izikhali, izinhlamvu, iziqhumane, iyunifomu yezempi/yamaphoyisa noma izinto zokulwa, ubunqunu/izithombe zocansi noma izinsiza zocansi, izidakamizwa ezilawulwayo, izimpahla ezintshontshiwe/umgunyathi, amadokhumenti omgunyathi, imikhonyovu/ukukhwabanisa, ukushushumbiswa kwabantu, izinto eziyingozi/zobuphekula, ukuhlukumeza ubumfihlo, nezinye izimpahla noma amasevisi angekho emthethweni. translations.New marketplace ads may be screened by a: New marketplace ads may be screened by automated safety checks and may remain pending until reviewed.
